product.olivetti-m6-620.summary: The desktop workstation that combined dual-channel SCSI and Ethernet on the motherboard.
product.olivetti-m6-620.history: The press presented the M6-620 as an Olivetti Pentium workstation. In April 1994, ASCII reported its Japanese offer at ¥998.000 with 210 MB.
product.olivetti-m6-620.architecture: The motherboard handles storage and networking. The AIC-7770 drives two SCSI channels and the Intel 82596DX handles Ethernet over EISA.
product.olivetti-m6-620.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-620.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
